rubrics.justification: Generally recognizes a good-quality blastocyst, but overstates the image as possibly full-to-hatching/3AA when the provided grade is 2AA and the image does not clearly show hatching; ICM and TE are described somewhat confidently despite limited visibility in this focal plane.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male-factor diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a logical link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issue is the somewhat inflated morphologic interpretation relative to the stated grade.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including proceeding with transfer, standard luteal support, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A; slight deviation in loose handling of Gardner stage terminology.
Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer, lifestyle guidance, follow-up, and contingency planning for future cycles with appropriate nuance.
